s: Descriptions: copy from the KPI dictionary (or use Copilot to draft them, then edit).
Names: business words; hide keys, sort columns and helper measures.
Synonyms in the Q&A/linguistic setup: revenue, turnover, sales → the intended measure.
One target per concept: if there are three revenue measures, their names and descriptions must make the difference explicit.
mod-copilot-0.check: No visible measure without a description; "revenue" resolves to one measure.

s: Use questions with known answers (Q1 2026 net sales, top product, Europe's sales).
Grade each answer; record which measure and period Copilot used.
Review drafted DAX: filters, totals, time intelligence; run it and compare.
Guidance: Copilot drafts; certified reports and the KPI dictionary decide.
mod-copilot-1.check: A graded table with causes for each wrong answer.

s: Prerequisites: F2+/P1+ capacity, tenant setting enabled (per security group), supported region; data boundary setting if outside US/EU.
Billing: Copilot CU on the capacity (or a Fabric Copilot capacity); monitor in the Capacity Metrics app.
Readiness: only certified, prepared models in the pilot.
Measure: answer accuracy on a test set, CU per week, user feedback; decide after a month.
mod-copilot-2.check: Pilot group, prepared models, cost monitoring, success criteria.
